adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and, for COLLECTIVE team events, `handleNewBooking` pushes additional hosts’ `destinationCalendar` entries onto `evt.destinationCalendar` (so it can contain multiple calendars). `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` now iterates over `event.destinationCalendar` and calls `createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)` per destination. However, `packages/app-store/larkcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` was updated to always take only the first destination calendar (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []; const calendarId = mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId;`) in both `createEvent` and `createAttendees`, ignoring which destination/credential is being processed. As a result, when multiple destination calendars exist, Lark event creation/attendee creation will target the first calendar’s `externalId` for all iterations rather than the intended per-host calendar.
